description: This file defines the AOD_Index class, which implements a deprecated indexing and search functionality for SuiteCRM using Zend Search Lucene. It includes methods for searching, indexing, removing documents, and managing Lucene index configuration.

classes.name: AOD_Index
classes.description: A deprecated class extending AOD_Index_sugar that provides search indexing, document creation, and index management functionalities using Zend Search Lucene within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Lucene search components and sets encoding and analysis. Deprecated since v7.12.0.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the indexing feature is enabled in configuration. Deprecated since v7.12.0.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Performs a search query on the Lucene index with converted query string. Deprecated since v7.12.0.

methods.name: optimise
methods.description: Optimizes the Lucene index and records the optimization time. Deprecated since v7.12.0.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the singleton index bean. Deprecated since v7.12.0.

methods.name: getDocumentForRevision
methods.description: Creates a Lucene document from a document revision, supporting various mime types. Deprecated since v7.12.0.

methods.name: getDocumentForBean
methods.description: Creates a Lucene document from a SugarBean, adding relevant fields based on the bean's properties. Deprecated since v7.12.0.

methods.name: getBoost
methods.description: Calculates a boost factor for a field based on module and field name. Deprecated since v7.12.0.

methods.name: getIndexEvent
methods.description: Creates or updates an index event bean for tracking indexing operations. Deprecated since v7.12.0.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits changes to the Lucene index. Deprecated since v7.12.0.

methods.name: isModuleSearchable
methods.description: Determines if a module is searchable based on whitelist and blacklist. Deprecated since v7.12.0.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Indexes a specific bean given its module and ID, updating the Lucene index and index event. Deprecated since v7.12.0.

methods.name: getIdForDoc
methods.description: Generates a unique document ID string for a given module and bean ID. Deprecated since v7.12.0.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes all Lucene documents associated with a module and bean ID from the index. Deprecated since v7.12.0.

methods.name: getLuceneIndex
methods.description: Provides access to the Lucene index, creating or opening it, and setting configurations. Deprecated since v7.12.0.

methods.name: getIndexableModules
methods.description: Returns a list of modules that are searchable based on 'isModuleSearchable'. Deprecated since v7.12.0.
